doc: Shared fault table for FAULT_STATUS.id (NavLink spec 14.1.1). The text for an id is fixed. generate.py validates this file and emits it beside the codec.

id_ranges.0x0100-0x01FF: core FC faults, assigned only in this file (0x0100 sensors, 0x0110 storage, 0x0120 estimation, 0x0130 power)
id_ranges.0x8000-0xFFFF: vendor / experimental; core never assigns here
